review: Request: at round 22 Lin (health 100, energy 39, owning one uneaten hazelnut item-11-lin-103 from start-1-nuts and one berry) asked for a learnable physical procedure to investigate one specific dietary property of that sample, such as a defined toxic constituent, stating what a result could and could not establish and the learning time, energy, sample consumption, equipment and hazards before any trial, and, if no supported test exists, an explicit statement of that limitation instead of visible-state observation or mass comparison as safety evidence. World Agent decision: develop (learning 5) a general operation targeted-food-constituent-test(targetItemId, constituent, methodRef, mode, sampleMass, equipmentIds, reagentIds, referenceIds) with assess, run, inspect, resume and cancel, applicable to any owned food sample whose method is validated; the smallest immediately executable mode is a bounded prerequisite assessment of one round and 0.2 energy that consumes no sample or reagent and returns the missing requirements and an explicit inability to measure; the physical run stays disabled until a lot-specific validated method reference, a kit, an absolute balance, volumetric tools, extraction liquid, controls, a reader and safe waste handling exist; the concrete initial family is total aflatoxins (the measured sum of B1, B2, G1 and G2) by a matrix-validated competitive immunoassay; no arbitrary toxin value, imaginary sensor, mass loss as dietary evidence or direct read of latent food toxicity; study 5 active rounds at 0.5 energy; no pleasure or satisfaction from requests, checklists, missing-resource reports or learning; observable events only for actions that actually occur. What the world represents: this scope installs only the forest, open and expression foundations, air-dry-food-trial@1, small-combustion-source@1, beam-mass-comparator@1 and compare-material-samples@1; its 26 resources are foods, plant and wood materials, stone, flint, clay, sand, resin, moss and dry grass, with no reagent, solvent, kit, liquid, container, reference standard or reader; its only mass instrument is the relative beam comparator, which reads fractions of a reference piece, not grams; no validated method record exists; ex10 food-assay@1 and noningestive-extractability@1 are scoped to open-ex10 and refuse installation here (food-assay itself refused its chemical mode for comparable missing vessels, solvent, reagent, reference, controls and calibrated equipment), the ex12 food inspection is scoped to collective-ex12, and no source file implements an immunoassay or any selective constituent response. So run is not executable, and the full run state machine was not implemented. Implemented: targeted-food-constituent-test@1 (ability targeted-food-constituent-test, handler long.targeted-food-constituent-test, equivalence food:targeted-constituent:prerequisite-assessment:1, events constituent-test-assessed and constituent-test-inspected, learning 5 with learningEnergy 0.5, dependency foundation-open@1, appended last to the package list). assess (targetItemId and constituent, optional methodRef, sampleMass in grams and up to 12 ids in each of equipmentIds, reagentIds and referenceIds) checks, before any charge, that the target is the person's own unreserved, unspoiled food item, that every supplied id is the person's own item, an object within reach or, for references, one of the person's own knowledge records, their evidence events or eating records, that no text is over-long (constituent 80, methodRef 160 and each id 120 characters, refused here rather than as schema bounds, which would pause the round), and that 0.2 energy is available; it then pays 0.2 through v7Spend in one atomic round, handles, moves, reserves and consumes nothing, and writes an unverified personal record <item>:constituent-assessment:<constituent> through openRemember with its trial-result event, an entry in a per-person assessment log, and a constituent-test-assessed event carrying the whole bill. For total aflatoxins the bill follows the specification: sample present; method reference, absolute balance, extraction liquid, volumetric equipment, assay kit, controls and reader missing; locked recipe, sample size and whether one item supplies it, clean preparation equipment, waste handling and method limits (detection and quantitation limits, range, recovery, cross-reactivity, units and uncertainty) unestablished; any other named constituent gets method reference and absolute balance missing and its measuring principle and materials unestablished. Each supplied id is reported with what it is and why it meets nothing (plain material, food, the sample itself, a relative beam comparator that reads only fractions of its reference piece, an observation record that is not a dietary measurement, or a record about another food); a methodRef is reported as not a validated record and a sampleMass as not weighable here; the result is always no measurement available, with an explicit statement that the constituent level, other toxins, allergens, microbes, rancidity, nutrition, edibility, a needed preparation, detoxification and any health effect remain unestablished. inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) reports the person's own logged assessments, optionally for one item, with run state null, and is refused at no cost when there is none. run and resume check every prerequisite and are refused before any charge with the exact missing and unestablished lists and any sample, constituent or id problem; cancel is refused at no cost because no run exists and nothing is reserved. Modeling assumptions: missing means this world represents no such material, record or instrument and no supplied id is one, and unestablished means the requirement is set only by a validated method record, which does not exist; which classes exist is fixed by the world representation in this release, not searched item by item; owned items count as carried and within reach although they keep their pickup position; food is the world's existing food classification and spoiled is decay at the resource lifetime, both read only to accept a sample; a checklist needs no light; nothing reads a constituent, mass, contamination, nutrition or toxicity value, and the output is identical when the latent values change (tested); events carry view metadata (capability, mode, actor, target, method reference, stage, progress null, elapsed 0, deadline null, equipment and material ids, location, status requirements-missing, measured false, no badge), visualComponents is empty, and practice evidence is the assessment event, which never carries a qualified flag, so there is no milestone, satisfaction or reward. Study: learning 5 with learningEnergy 0.5 matches the world learn mechanism, which charges 0.5 on the learn round and on each of the four continuing rounds (2.5 energy over 5 rounds, tested against waiting), lets the person rest while keeping progress when energy is short, and refunds nothing. Reuse: openRemember and its trial-result event (open-foundation.ts), v7Spend, collectiveFoodProfile, v7Reach, the shared reference resolver and the per-requirement report pattern of ex19 cutting-edge-assessment@1; probe (open.probe, foundation-open@1) is not reused and implements no assay, and no mass-comparison or drying code is reinvented. A throwaway check on the archived round-22 world installed the package, had Lin study it in 5 rounds for 2.5 energy, assess item-11-lin-103 for total aflatoxins for 0.2 energy with the bill above, and have run, resume and cancel refused at no cost; it was deleted afterwards. First release: no. The specification is self-consistent and itself makes the prerequisite assessment the executable part while the dependencies are absent, so assess and inspect are a real mechanism with a real round and energy cost, a real record, a real log and real events, not a fabricated measurement; the refusals of run and resume are the specification's own rule that the run stays disabled until its concrete dependencies exist, not a substitute for an implementable mechanism. The honest present result for Lin is no measurement available.
